verdict.rationale: Teams exposes programmatic APIs (Microsoft Graph, bots, webhooks), so issuing scoped credentials for an agent is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents permission scopes, least-privilege app credentials, or per-agent token issuance. Mentions of the Graph API and of Azure resource provisioning are adjacent building blocks, not evidence of scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
